title.fa: پانصد سال بالا رفتن: هشت پلهٔ قدرتِ روحانیت
title.en: Five centuries of rising: eight steps of clerical power
title.nl: Five centuries of rising: eight steps of clerical power

summary.fa: روحانیتِ شیعه یک‌شبه قدرت نگرفت: تا ۱۵۰۱ میلادی اکثریتِ ایران سنی بود و بعد، هشت پلهٔ انباشتِ نهادی که هیچ‌کدام بعداً پس گرفته نشد. درسِ امروز: سازمان‌یافتگی، نه محبوبیت، تعیین‌کنندهٔ برنده است.
summary.en: The Shia clergy did not take power overnight: until 1501 most Iranians were Sunni; then eight steps of institutional accumulation, none later reversed. The lesson for today: organisation, not popularity, picks the winner.
summary.nl: The Shia clergy did not take power overnight: until 1501 most Iranians were Sunni; then eight steps of institutional accumulation, none later reversed. The lesson for today: organisation, not popularity, picks the winner.

text.fa: پلهٔ یکم، صفوی: علما وارد شدند، حوزه ساخته شد، اوقاف (زمین، بازار، مدرسه، کاروانسرا) به آن‌ها سپرده شد؛ گروهِ عالم مالک شد.
text.en: Step 1, Safavid: clergy arrived, the seminary was built and endowments were entrusted to them; scholars became owners.
text.nl: Step 1, Safavid: clergy arrived, the seminary was built and endowments were entrusted to them; scholars became owners.

text.fa: پلهٔ دوم، نادرشاه: پس از سقوطِ اصفهان در ۱۷۲۲ نادر خواست تشیع را از هویتِ رسمی پایین بکشد (مذهبِ پنجمِ «جعفری»)؛ علما به عتباتِ زیرِ حاکمیتِ عثمانی رفتند و نهاد را بیرون از دسترسِ حاکمِ ایرانی از نو ساختند. این نقش بزرگ‌نمایی شده است: مهاجرت پیش از او هم بود.
text.en: Step 2, Nader Shah: after Isfahan fell in 1722 Nader tried to lower Shi'ism from the official identity; clergy went to the Ottoman-ruled shrine cities and rebuilt the institution beyond the Iranian ruler's reach. The role is exaggerated: migration predates him.
text.nl: Step 2, Nader Shah: after Isfahan fell in 1722 Nader tried to lower Shi'ism from the official identity; clergy went to the Ottoman-ruled shrine cities and rebuilt the institution beyond the Iranian ruler's reach. The role is exaggerated: migration predates him.

text.fa: پلهٔ سوم، نبردِ اصولی و اخباری: پیروزیِ اصولی‌ها (وحید بهبهانی) یعنی تقلید از مجتهدِ زنده واجب است، که سه چیز می‌سازد: سلسله‌مراتب، پیرو (مقلد) و خزانه (خمس).
text.en: Step 3, Usuli versus Akhbari: the Usuli victory (Behbahani) made following a living jurist obligatory, creating hierarchy, followers and a treasury.
text.nl: Step 3, Usuli versus Akhbari: the Usuli victory (Behbahani) made following a living jurist obligatory, creating hierarchy, followers and a treasury.

text.fa: پلهٔ چهارم، قاجار: ایلِ بدونِ ادعای دینی مشروعیت را از علما خرید؛ در این معامله طرفی که نیاز بیشتری داشت (دولت) ضعیف‌تر بود.
text.en: Step 4, Qajar: a tribe with no religious claim bought legitimacy from the clergy; the party with more need, the state, was weaker.
text.nl: Step 4, Qajar: a tribe with no religious claim bought legitimacy from the clergy; the party with more need, the state, was weaker.

text.fa: پلهٔ پنجم، جهاد: در جنگ‌های ایران و روس فقها اختیارِ اعلامِ جهادِ ابتدایی را که از امامِ معصوم بود به خود گرفتند؛ جنگ باخته شد اما هزینهٔ سیاسی را دولت پرداخت نه روحانیت.
text.en: Step 5, jihad: in the Russo-Persian wars jurists took the authority to declare offensive jihad, which belonged to the infallible imam; the war was lost but the state paid the political cost.
text.nl: Step 5, jihad: in the Russo-Persian wars jurists took the authority to declare offensive jihad, which belonged to the infallible imam; the war was lost but the state paid the political cost.

text.fa: پلهٔ ششم، انصاری و پول: پس از ۱۸۵۰ یک نفر مرجعِ بلامنازعِ جهانِ شیعه شد و نظامِ وجوهات را قاعده‌مند کرد. «موقوفهٔ اوده» (پولِ هند که بریتانیا توزیع می‌کرد) تصویرِ استقلالِ کاملِ مالی را پیچیده‌تر می‌کند، اما پژوهش نشان می‌دهد پول‌دادن لزوماً کنترل نخرید.
text.en: Step 6, Ansari and money: after 1850 one man became the undisputed authority of the Shia world and regularised dues. The Oudh Bequest (Indian money distributed by Britain) complicates the picture of full financial independence, but research shows paying did not buy control.
text.nl: Step 6, Ansari and money: after 1850 one man became the undisputed authority of the Shia world and regularised dues. The Oudh Bequest (Indian money distributed by Britain) complicates the picture of full financial independence, but research shows paying did not buy control.

text.fa: پلهٔ هفتم، باب: جنبشِ بابی روحانیتِ رسمی را کنارِ دولت به‌عنوانِ نگهبانِ نظم تعریف کرد و یک دشمنِ درونیِ دائمی داد.
text.en: Step 7, the Bab: the Babi movement defined the official clergy as a guardian of order beside the state and gave it a permanent internal enemy.
text.nl: Step 7, the Bab: the Babi movement defined the official clergy as a guardian of order beside the state and gave it a permanent internal enemy.

text.fa: پلهٔ هشتم، امتیازات و کشفِ اهرم: امتیازِ رویتر (۱۸۷۲) و تنباکو (۱۸۹۰). تحریمِ سراسری کار کرد و قرارداد در ۱۸۹۲ لغو شد؛ ائتلافِ بازار و روحانیت (یکی پول دارد و دیگری مشروعیت) موتورِ ۱۸۹۱، مشروطه و ۱۳۵۷ شد.
text.en: Step 8, concessions and discovering leverage: the Reuter (1872) and tobacco (1890) concessions. The nationwide boycott worked and the contract was cancelled in 1892; the bazaar-clergy coalition (one has money, the other legitimacy) was the engine of 1891, the Constitution and 1979.
text.nl: Step 8, concessions and discovering leverage: the Reuter (1872) and tobacco (1890) concessions. The nationwide boycott worked and the contract was cancelled in 1892; the bazaar-clergy coalition (one has money, the other legitimacy) was the engine of 1891, the Constitution and 1979.

text.fa: ۱۳۵۷: مردم مذهبی‌تر از دهه‌های پیش نشده بودند؛ پرسشِ درست این است که چرا وقتی رژیم افتاد فقط یک نیرو آمادهٔ گرفتنِ قدرت بود (حزب توده پس از ۱۳۳۲ متلاشی شد، جبههٔ ملی فلج شد). سازمان‌یافتگی، نه محبوبیت، برنده بود.
text.en: Nineteen seventy-nine: people had not become more religious; the right question is why only one force was ready to take power when the regime fell. Organisation, not popularity, won.
text.nl: Nineteen seventy-nine: people had not become more religious; the right question is why only one force was ready to take power when the regime fell. Organisation, not popularity, won.
